title: Dougal Shaw (BBC News / Business Leader) — 'Corruption breaks the logic of capitalism'
summary: Shaw interviewed entrepreneurs at BBC News for a decade and writes for Business Leader. His review of Incorruptible on LinkedIn Pulse centres on the public benefit corporation as the structure Ries sets against the duty a board owes shareholders, and on his point that the approaches which save companies can be taught.
blockquote: This 'corruption breaks the logic of capitalism,' Ries argues, in a striking sentence… The PBC is the critical antidote to the fiduciary duty trap, he believes. The approaches that save companies are not only proven, but also learnable.
